prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE image, then copy the resulting image file to incoming/alcove-winter.png in this repo. Use a 16:9 landscape size at the highest quality. Do not edit any other files. When done, print the saved path and the pixel dimensions.
The attached image (incoming/alcove-autumn.png) is the reference: pass it to the image generation tool as the input image to edit, so the camera, framing and materials stay identical.

Image prompt:
Using the reference image, keep the camera position, framing, plaster wall, wooden floor board, pine post, bronze basin and stone exactly the same. Change only the season to midwinter: remove the maple leaves; the moss is dulled to a muted olive green with white frost crystals along its edges; a thin dusting of fresh snow sits on the very top of the stone. Cool, pale, low winter daylight from the left. Muted, natural colours, realistic photograph. No text, no people, no other objects. 16:9.
